subject: [RFC PATCH 56/57] selftests/mm: cover the scaled max_ptes_shared limit

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm/khugepaged.c file, which covers the scaled max_ptes_shared limit. The current implementation of max_ptes_shared counts PTEs in whole PMDs but fails to account for smaller ranges that are scanned in full and judged against the same setting. This leads to incorrect results when checking if a range should collapse. To fix this issue, the patch introduces a new test case that checks both directions in one sub-PMD range with a forked child holding shared sources. The counts used in the test come from the current max_ptes_shared rather than being hardcoded, allowing the test to follow the setting and order it runs at.
